name: István Kovács
bio:
István's motorsport journey began in his youth, fueled by a fascination with the technical intricacies of race cars. He honed his analytical skills through a degree in mechanical engineering, quickly applying his knowledge to racing simulations and data analysis. His meticulous approach caught the eye of a small Hungarian racing team, where he served as a junior strategist, learning the ropes and proving his aptitude for race-day decision making. 

After several successful seasons, István sought opportunities on a larger stage, joining a European GT team. There, he refined his understanding of tire management, fuel strategy, and the impact of changing weather conditions. István is known for his data-driven approach. He is a demanding leader, expecting his team to be as thorough and prepared as he is, ensuring no detail is overlooked. This focus on precision and rigorous planning makes him a valuable asset, capable of extracting every ounce of performance from the car and driver.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: István has a serious demeanor etched on his face, framed by wire-rimmed glasses.

quirks: Always carries a worn notebook filled with calculations and notes.
Insists on drinking strong black coffee before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
